title: export profile
description: A shape profile another installed Gen1Recomp mod ships (docs/specs/PROFILE_PLAN.md): Dramaless Shape's hand-authored data/voxel_heights.lua, as text, unparsed. Read by the builder and this player's own client only; the file never leaves this machine. Absent when that mod isn't installed.

mod.description: The mod id the file was read from.

file.description: The file, relative to the mod's folder.

enabled.description: Whether Gen1Recomp runs the mod. The bridge only reads its table, so it should be disabled.

text.description: The file's text (UTF-8). Lua that is only data: never run, only read.
